protocol.authorization: 2026-11-21 user explicitly authorized16.1-3 exploratory revision; original15.4 formal estimand/gates retained separately
protocol.validation: 2022/23 forward ranking before2024 bridge scoring;2024 previously inspected diagnostic,2025 sealed
protocol.shadow: ALL inherited common boundaries; past-calibration role-specific run thresholds, two adjacent same-half same-appearance PAs, maxone/appearance; unified SP-to-RP team2PA cooldown. Original observed history continues after alert; NOT counterfactual full-game path. Unknown/gaps reset persistence.
protocol.case_selection: 2024 common-clock games ordered by md5(str(game_pk)), first32; ALL boundaries retained regardless alert/action/outcome. Historical legal cohort is retrospectively selected, not deployment population.
protocol.candidate: strictly earlier nominal roster snapshot; exclude already-entered pitchers at anchor and outgoing, require previous RP role. No current-active/warmup/medical inference. Own ability/load/recent closed-history ASOF anchor, no incumbent live features on replacements.
protocol.bridge: 9-class PA observed actual actor including replacement entries. Common anchor before PA start; require matching initial outs/bases/scores, single actor, organic PA, legal runner conservation. Normalize post_base=0 when outs_after=3 (official raw residual runners are not a live next state). Actual actor used as training label/action, never future batter predictor. Entry and incumbent support separately reported.
protocol.implementation_revision: attempt0 preserves initial string-state adapter/slow replay; attempt1 preserves incorrect raw third-out residual-base exclusion and all provisional fits/scenarios. Neither used for final research. Correct absorbing third-out state before any label support filter, retrain/reselect all folds.
protocol.fit: whole-game chronological80/20 fit/cal, spanning games excluded; fixed natural60000 fit cap; HGB7leaves60iterations/minleaf200/L2=10/lr.05; one-hot cats, temperature .5-3. Rank base/rich on2022/23 meanLL, no2024 selection. No ID encoded.
protocol.pool_law: uniform over own-history-supported nominal RP pool, at least2; no individual ranking. Full, rest>=24h,72h pitches<=40 sensitivity, no retuning.
protocol.next_pa: paired256paths; same anchor, full organic PA and conditional training-only legal runner transitions, frozen WE/RE. Excludes intervening non-PA events and IBB; conditional organic-PA scenario, not complete action-policy value.
protocol.half: hold selected pitcher to current half end, no later substitutions; same paired random numbers; forecast first3 slots from past, fourth+ previous-UTC-day league prior; first PA selected bridge, later base bridge without frozen live states. Simulated PA pitch increments sampled from training by role/outcome; later inter-PA rest uses past training within-inning incumbent median (never retain pre-entry rest). No simulated future Stuff/PE.32PA cap.
protocol.support: own role history>=30 PA, known prior hand, complete14day pitch history; >=30 training labels per role/is_current; first-PA numeric range checks; max unsupported category mass per path<=.01, no capped path or model pitch-range extrapolation for supported half direction.
protocol.intervals: paired MC95 conditional fixed models/transitions/WE; NOT model/causal uncertainty. Mean case differences game-cluster descriptive95, samplecases not league policy effect. Unselected base/rich alternative and availability sensitivity separate.
protocol.formal_offpolicy: SNIPS/DR withheld: inherited SMD fails, missing common-clock joint candidate/availability propensities and aligned subsequent behavior policy. Do not reuse observed half outcomes to validate hold-pitcher policy when later actual substitutions differ.

formal_methods.direct: conditional model scenarios only, not causal policy value

methodNotes: 16.1是沿實際歷史的影子回放；發出提醒後仍使用實際投手後續資料，不是照建議改寫整場比賽。
提醒沿15.5下一PA失分風險，不是已通過四群燈號／替代收益的換投建議；實際換投對應不等於正確率。
16.2是下一完整一般打席；16.3是兩方案皆由選定投手投到半局結束的模型情境。未模擬IBB／獨立跑者事件、熱身、醫療、後續換投與牛棚長期成本。
共同截點比較模型同時包含實際續投與接任案例；人選只用自身截點前能力、72／120小時負荷與最近三次已閉合且同量測版本的登板摘要，候補當場數據未知。
只首PA可使用現任即時PE／狀態；後續回到共同基準，球數依訓練分布更新，不把當下下降固定延伸到局末。預定前三棒來自過去棒次，第四棒後回聯盟先驗。
點區間只含配對蒙地卡羅誤差；全案例平均另列比賽群聚描述區間，重疊決策點不可加總成球隊收益或當成獨立決策。
第一PA外推診斷另列各欄位，不可加總重複人選。歷史打席數自然累積超過訓練上限也會被保守範圍門檻拒絕，並非缺少打者／投手資料；本輪不事後放寬，可另版研究有效樣本數飽和或有界表示。
原15.4正式資格保留，SMD未重估，SNIPS／DR尚不具共同人選／可用性與後續策略支持。探索研究完成不代表正式效益通過；2024是重用診斷、2025封存。
